quotes: Impeccable service, divine food
Haughty, condescending, and supercilious behavior from nearly all we encountered.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers describe the room as beautiful, elegant and cozy, though one found their table horrible and the room loud.
quotes: Sophisticated dining room, friendly wait staff. Atmosphere was lovely.
The ambiance is not attractive. Loud.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some say the high prices are worth it, while others find the restaurant, certain dishes or drinks overpriced.
quotes: Fancy French restaurant. Very good food. Pricey. Worth it.
Typical overpriced Manhattan restaurant

themes.label: Reservations and brunch
themes.text: Brunch is praised as a good way in, while dinner reservations are hard to get and need weeks of advance booking.
quotes: Having to reserve weeks in advance though doesn't live up to the expectation.
This is a great upscale brunch place! I would recommend this to anyone.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise attentive, impeccable service, but several describe slow, inattentive or disorganized staff, long gaps between visits, and a rude host.
quotes: Incredible service & the food is so well done - the fusilli & octopus is awesome
Dirty plates sat on the table for 20 minutes before being bussed.

themes.label: Pasta dishes
themes.text: Pasta, especially the fusilli with octopus, is repeatedly called outstanding or the best, though a couple of reviewers found some pasta heavy or too salty.
quotes: The best pasta in New York City
The pastas can be a bit heavy, but they're good.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many say the set or tasting menu is good value and worth the cost, while others note it is pricey or not matching the price.
quotes: Had the set menu, which was great value for money and by no means left us hungry!
Delicious overall, but a natural level when compared to price.

themes.label: Seafood quality
themes.text: Reviewers praise fresh seafood, including crudo, octopus, scallops, oysters, uni and lobster.
quotes: Fresh and well prepared seafood
The oysters were also very fresh with a sweet taste.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: The room is described as lovely, classy and pleasant, with a comfortable setting near Central Park.
quotes: cozy and classy setting across the street from Central Park.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the food, especially the pasta, though a few find it merely good, bland or too salty.
quotes: Very good,one of the best pasta I ever had!!Pizza bread and cold pressed juice is very good as well.
The ravioli is my favorite in the city.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers like the vibe, decor and lively setting, though some mention noise, cramped seating and uncomfortable chairs.
quotes: Amazing Italian restaurant for both cool atmosphere and wonderful food!!
The biggest but it was the amount of noise that there was, which made having a conversation with the person in front of you difficult.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many praise attentive, friendly service, but a few describe slow, sloppy or judgmental service.
quotes: Great place for brunch. Attentive service.
The service on a Sunday was obscenely slow

themes.label: Price and portions
themes.text: Several reviewers find the restaurant expensive and portions small, though one says the price is worth it.
quotes: I would say over priced given the portion sizes.
Always a good meal and service, nice wine list, but bring your wallet

themes.label: Brunch
themes.text: Brunch is repeatedly praised, with ricotta pancakes, waffle and Bloody Marys mentioned, though one reviewer found it disappointing.
quotes: I've only been for brunch but it's fantastic every time.
If you're there at brunch, try their ricotta pancakes!

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the food as excellent, with pastas, seafood, meat and desserts singled out, though a few found dishes bland, dry or ordinary.
quotes: The spaghetti was impressive, a great combination of crab, bottarga, lemon zest, and chilies, amazing flavor from the ocean with a hint of citrus and pungency.
the steak for $46 had three small, dry pieces, dessert was unimpressive.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers describe attentive, knowledgeable, professional staff, but several report poor, slow, rude or inattentive service.
quotes: The staff was extremely attentive, knowledgeable and friendly.
The service was poor. The waitress was not attentive and let the food sit in the kitchen.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many call it expensive and question the value compared with other New York options, while some find it fair, reasonable or worth the cost.
quotes: For the price tag, I think there are better experiences in the city.
Yes they are on the pricier side but totally worth it.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Many praise the elegant, spacious, beautifully decorated room, while others find it stuffy, sterile, corporate or too loud near the bar.
quotes: Tables well spaced, beautiful room, great food, fine service.
The atmosphere is corporate and sterile.

themes.label: Wait for table
themes.text: A few reviewers complained about long waits to be seated despite having reservations.
quotes: Waited for a long long time to get seated

themes.label: High prices for the food
themes.text: Many reviewers call the restaurant expensive or overpriced, some saying the food is only average takeout quality, while a few accept the cost as luxury.
quotes: The food is okay, but the price just doesn't make sense.
this place charges insane prices for lower quality food than you would get at your local Chinese food takeout restaurant

themes.label: Food quality and consistency
themes.text: Some find the food delicious and classic, while others call it bland, mediocre or disappointing, and a few note it is inconsistent.
quotes: Fantastic Chinese food- Some of the best in the city!
Portions still large but incredibly bland.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many praise attentive, excellent service, but others report slow, rushed, sporadic or rude service, including a tip demand.
quotes: the service was ridiculously slow from the servers
Staff was able to accomodate for my wife's allergies. superb service.

themes.label: Dim sum and cafe
themes.text: Reviewers like the dim sum, especially the carts, and the less formal, cheaper cafe, which is also convenient before Lincoln Center.
quotes: Lots of dim sum options that go around in carts.
The cafe is a wonderfully convenient place pre-Lincoln Center with fast service and generally delicious food.

themes.label: Dated decor and cleanliness
themes.text: Some admire the dragon and glamorous room, while others find it dated or dirty, with messy restrooms mentioned.
quotes: The place looked very dated and dirty.
Beautifully decorated with an amazing lit dragon

themes.label: Authentic Mexican food
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the food as delicious, authentic Mexican, and several name it their favorite local spot, though a few call it bad or bland.
quotes: Delicious autgentic Mexican food and great price.
Favorite Mexican restaurant, everything is authentic and the service is great.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, polite and good service, but one reviewer found the front-desk staff rude and unprofessional.
quotes: Excellent service, clean atmosphere, but most important real authentic Mexican food.
The young lady at the front is very rude and unprofessional.

themes.label: Long waits and delays
themes.text: Some reviewers report long waits for food or delivery, from 40 minutes to an hour, and a late opening time.
quotes: our food took 50 minutes too much time and they were not busy
Waited over 40 mins inside the restaurant for 3 tacos

themes.label: Quesadillas
themes.text: Quesadillas are singled out as excellent, with generous chicken and cheese, though one reviewer noted the mixtas lack chorizo.
quotes: We ordered the chicken quesadilla and it was excellent. There was a lot of chicken and cheese.
The best quesadillas of the Bronx

themes.label: Small quiet space
themes.text: The room is described as small, quiet, clean and comfortable, though not impressive looking and unsuited to larger groups.
quotes: This unassuming restaurant has just 4 table and really wonderful authentic Mexican food.
Small place. Do not expect to bring a group of 5 or more in here.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious and fresh, naming dishes such as goat, oxtail, steak and flan, though a few found some dishes bland or dry.
quotes: Had the oxtail and the goat. Very tender meat, well seasoned. Also tried the flan, which was very tasty.
The food here is absolutely delicious! I come by here occasionally and the food never disappoints.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Staff are mostly described as friendly, attentive and outstanding, but several reviewers found service slow and one walked out after an hour.
quotes: The guys attending to our table were so focused on giving us great service and they certainly achieved it.
Terrible service. After waiting for an hour for our food we walked out.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Reviewers find prices reasonable and portions generous, saying they get their money's worth, though one complained about a price jump.
quotes: I even had leftovers to take home since the plates are big. You definitely get your money's worth.
Yesterday's price 7.99, today same item, $12.00 , what gives?

themes.label: Cozy atmosphere
themes.text: The place is described as cozy, quiet and welcoming, good for couples and families, with nice decor and music.
quotes: Nice small and cozy place. Food and service was really good.
The food is ridiculously good and the restaurant is warm and welcoming.

themes.label: Food quality and tapas
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the food as delicious, with tapas and paella singled out, though a few found it salty, unremarkable or poor.
quotes: The Paella is amazing. AMAZING.
Great atmosphere and the best Tapas around.

themes.label: Atmosphere and ambiance
themes.text: Reviewers describe a warm, cozy, relaxed and stylish setting that suits dates and friends, with a few calling it quiet.
quotes: This place is quiet, but has a warm atmosphere and is just the right mix of hip and charming.
Very nice and suddle if your looking for a relaxed ambience.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many praise friendly, attentive staff and bartenders, but some describe slow, inattentive or rude service.
quotes: Great staff who care about you.
They take forever to bring out drinks and food.

themes.label: Drinks and cocktails
themes.text: Margaritas, tequila and the drinks menu earn praise, though one reviewer found the drinks too strong and another got stale wine.
quotes: Excellent tapas and delicious margaritas
But their drinks are way too strong.

themes.label: Live music and events
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy live music, a live band, flamenco dancers and themed nights.
quotes: Great food great atmosphere love the live band
Live music here as well.

themes.label: Pizza quality
themes.text: Many call the thin-crust pizza amazing and well made, while a few found it tasteless, greasy or mediocre.
quotes: Awesome pizza! Great dough, quality toppings. Real Italian stuff.
The pizza was tasteless and greasy.

themes.label: Service
themes.text: Most praise friendly, attentive staff, but some found service slow, cold, spotty or rushed.
quotes: Servers are sweet and don't rush you.
Slow and inattentive service.

themes.label: Pasta dishes
themes.text: Pasta is often called delicious and fresh, but some reviewers found it overcooked, dry or bland.
quotes: the pasta dishes were so fresh and amazing
Thin crust pizza is very good, but sometimes pasta is overcooked.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Many find prices reasonable for the quality, while others call it overpriced or say portions are small.
quotes: Added bonus that it's very reasonable.
I was hungry when I left and paid 30$

themes.label: Noise and atmosphere
themes.text: Some enjoy the bustling, lively ambience, while others find it very loud, crowded and dark.
quotes: this was the noisiest dinner out I've ever had. Could barely hear the people with me.

themes.label: Friendly, great service
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise friendly, attentive staff and service, with several saying they were a highlight of the visit.
quotes: was greeted with friendly staff and delicious food
Nice atmosphere but the best part is the staff.

themes.label: Tasty food
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the food as delicious, fresh and well made, naming the bean burger, fish and chips and potato leek soup.
quotes: The fish and chips were crispy and light, I will definitely be back.
Ingredients were fresh and food was tasty.

themes.label: Cocktails and drinks
themes.text: Most praise the cocktails, Guinness and beer selection, but one reviewer got a pricey, watered-down Jack and Coke.
quotes: nice selection of beer and a proper Pint of Guinness
got a $12 watered down Jack and Coke

themes.label: Build-your-own burger
themes.text: Reviewers like building their own burger, saying it was done perfectly and offered good value.
quotes: You can also build your own burger however you want for a very good price.
Twice I did build my burger. Perfectly done.

themes.label: Atmosphere and setting
themes.text: Reviewers describe a comfortable, cozy, low-key neighbourhood bar atmosphere, though one review just describes a standard pub layout.
quotes: We found this cozy tavern by accident, but we will be back!
Great neighbourhood bar with friendly staff

themes.label: Excellent attentive service
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly single out friendly, attentive, personal service and staff who go out of their way, such as kitchen tours and special touches.
quotes: What made a great meal a great memory was the service. Attentive, caring, personal and personable.
The thing that stood out the most was the kind and friendly staff, who after our meal, gave us a tour of the kitchen

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Food is described as amazing, creative and well prepared, with praise for dishes such as lamb, tartare, monkfish and the tasting menus.
quotes: I had a special which was monk fish and it was perfectly cooked.
Every single dish/drink we had was amazing. You cannot order something bad.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Some find it too expensive for what is offered, while others say the cost is justified by the food and service.
quotes: too expensive for what they offer.
Little expensive but the food is worth it.

themes.label: Ambience and bar area
themes.text: Reviewers like the pretty, elegant space and lively bar and tavern area, though one notes it can get crowded and loud.
quotes: a drink and light bites in what has to be one of the prettiest bar areas of any restaurant
Can get very very busy, have long waits and be sort of over crowded & loud

themes.label: Waits and reservation problems
themes.text: A few reviewers describe long waits, being ignored or not seated despite a reservation, and slow drink service.
quotes: Reservation was at 9:15pm, by 10:15pm we were never seated, so we left.
Once seated we were left to wait for over 20 minutes without drinks or any semblance of orders.

themes.label: Food quality and flavor
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the food as delicious, fresh and flavorful, naming gnocchi, pasta, lasagna, charcuterie and the porchetta sandwich.
quotes: Sweet potato gnocchi was phenomenal!
Truly fresh and taste filled ingredients

themes.label: Portion size
themes.text: Many find the small plates too small and unsatisfying, while others like sharing them or find the serving size just right.
quotes: The $32 we ordered of entre was barely enough food for one person, let alone two.
Very small dishes, not for lunch if you are hungry. Just snacking

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some call it pricey or overpriced for the portions, while others find prices reasonable, affordable or good value.
quotes: Great Italian food at very affordable prices.
dishes are small (including the "large" portions) and very overpriced.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Staff are mostly described as friendly, attentive and welcoming, though one reviewer found service inconsistent between visits.
quotes: Great small restaurant with quality ingredients and attentive staff.
The service either... it's not consistent.

themes.label: Small, crowded space
themes.text: Reviewers describe a tiny, tight room that is hard to get into or crowded, though others find it cozy and romantic.
quotes: Very small as far as seating is concerned, so can be hard to get a seat on the weekends.
It has a very romantic yet homey feel inside.

themes.label: Burgers
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the burgers as good, juicy and satisfying, though a few call them unremarkable or poor in quality.
quotes: Great burgers. Super juicy and delicious.
Nothing over the top in terms of a burger. It's good though.

themes.label: Mac and cheese
themes.text: The mac and cheese and Mac and Joe are repeatedly called delicious and a favorite, with one reviewer calling it popular.
quotes: The Mac and Cheese was something I've never had before. It was thick.
Nice concept,love the Mac and cheese, perfect location and staff is very friendly

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many find prices reasonable or affordable, while others call the food overpriced, pricey, or small in portion for the cost.
quotes: Prices are very affordable.
Too costly for not so good food

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many praise friendly, fast service, but some report rude or grumpy staff, wrong orders and slow food preparation.
quotes: Fast, friendly service. And my salad was really good!
Cashier got order wrong twice, food preparation time is surprisingly slow

themes.label: Milkshakes
themes.text: Handcrafted milkshakes, including chocolate and malted flavors, are described as excellent and among the best.
quotes: The milkshakes are the best!
Do not, I repeat do not hesitate to order one!

themes.label: Sushi freshness and quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise fresh, high-quality sushi and fish, though some say quality has dropped over time or taste was average and bland.
quotes: this is the freshest we've had in America. Not the cheapest however
Used to have fantastic in fresh sushi but something has changed. The quality of the food has significantly dropped

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Many reviewers find prices reasonable and lunch specials good value, with generous food for the cost, though one notes it is not the cheapest.
quotes: We got the lunch specials and got a lot of food for a low price, would recommend!
One of the top quality sushi places at affordable price in Manhattan!

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive staff, but others report slow, inattentive or unfriendly service and a surprise tip charge.
quotes: Extremely friendly and knowledgeable staff.
Quite literally the worst service I have ever experienced. On a relatively slow night, ignored for 20 minutes before my order was taken.

themes.label: Delivery experience
themes.text: Some praise fast, reliable delivery, while others describe missed or misdelivered orders, cold food and disputes over what was ordered.
quotes: Great food, incredibly reliable, whip fast delivery, I am very lucky they are in the area.
The food did not arrive on time. I called the restaurant and they told me they delivered the food.

themes.label: Space, noise and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers like the large, cozy space with seating options, but mention loud music, crowding downstairs and worn banquettes.
quotes: it's a massive space with high ceilings that's a very welcoming space.
Downstairs can be hot, crowded and especially noisy.

themes.label: Sandwiches and salads
themes.text: Reviewers frequently praise specific sandwiches and salads, such as the roast beef, buttermilk chicken and avocado sandwiches and the arugula salad, though a few found the food bland or unpleasant.
quotes: Try the roast beef sandwich and confit duck leg, they will blow your mind!
Obsessed with the Arugula Salad. Delicious!

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many call the prices affordable or good value for the area, while others find it pricey for average food.
quotes: Prices are lower then average and value is higher.
Very expensive average food. What did you expect....its NYC

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, quick, helpful staff, but some report rude service, rushing, or poor handling of food allergies.
quotes: the service is quick and friendly, the wine and drinks list top notch and reasonably priced.
Rudest service I've ever had from start to finish. Threw our food on the table.

themes.label: Lincoln Center location
themes.text: Reviewers value its convenience for a meal before or after shows and movies at Lincoln Center.
quotes: Great salad or sandwich place at Lincoln Center. Good for before or after shows.
Almost a Lincoln Center secret.

themes.label: Wine and coffee
themes.text: Reviewers like the wine list, generous pours and the coffee.
quotes: Good food and ridiculously generous wine pours.
The wines are very interesting and the food very good.

themes.label: Old-school NY style pizza
themes.text: Reviewers praise the authentic, traditional New York slice, with good sauce, cheese and crust, and often call it the best in the neighborhood or city.
quotes: For a great, simple NY slice, Sam's is the place. One of the best in the city.
Authentic old school thin slice greasy tasty pizza. Large slice.

themes.label: Big slices and portions
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly note the slices and meals are very large, and some link this to fair prices.
quotes: The pizza is MASSIVE. Pretty good too.
They serve big portions for convenient prices.

themes.label: Friendly staff and service
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, family-run service, but a few report being ignored or kept waiting while others were served.
quotes: The customer service is constantly speedy, good character, very friendly staff members.
they all got served before us. We got tired of waiting so long that we left

themes.label: Fresh made-to-order pizza and waits
themes.text: Many like that pizza is made fresh in front of them, though this can mean long waits for pies.
quotes: So always fresh pizza from very beginning.
Call and order or you will have to wait 30 minutes while they prepare it in front of you

themes.label: Cash only, no delivery
themes.text: A few reviewers mention the shop takes only cash and does not deliver, though they still rate the pizza highly.
quotes: The only con is that they don't deliver and they don't take cards.
The only downside is that they only accept cash

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise attentive, warm service, but a few found it snobbish, intrusive, slow, or the host rude.
quotes: The kind and warm service was the best surprise.
the service was snobbish and below average

themes.label: Noise level
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the dining room as very loud, with the back area and evenings noisiest.
quotes: This place is loud. Like hard to have a conversation loud.
it gets terribly noisy in the back area, as the evening wears on

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable, especially at lunch, while others call the food overpriced for small portions or unremarkable dishes.
quotes: The lunch meals are really well priced and is good Bistro food.

themes.label: Wine list
themes.text: Many praise the wines and knowledgeable staff, though some say the all-natural list is hard to navigate or house wines could improve.
quotes: the wine list is a little difficult to navigate being all natural wines

themes.label: Fries and duck
themes.text: Reviewers single out the frites and the duck as standout dishes, though one found the fries only ok.
quotes: this reataurant gets 5 stars because of the BEST FRIES ON THE PLANET.
the duck melted in the mouth

themes.label: Rude staff and customer service
themes.text: Many reviewers describe rude, nasty or disrespectful staff and managers, while others call the workers decent, friendly, professional and the service excellent.
quotes: He acts like you are bothering him and hangs up before you can even confirm that he took your order.
The guys behind the Deli are pros and they always remember how I like my sandwich.

themes.label: Wrong or messed-up orders
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly report orders arriving incorrect, with missing items or mistakes, even when the order was read back.
quotes: The girl that answers the phone always takes down the wrong order even when she reads it back it still arrives incorrectly.
they gave me everything wrong. When I called to change it, it took another hour.

themes.label: Delivery speed and handling
themes.text: Several reviewers complain of two-hour waits and delivery problems, such as missing change, while one finds delivery fast.
quotes: It takes almost 2 hours for a delivery and it always arrives incorrect.
Delivery is fast, we love Enrique who always has a smile on his face.

themes.label: Sandwiches and deli food
themes.text: Reviewers praise the sandwiches, deli meats and fresh, tasty food, including a chicken cutlet hero.
quotes: Best chicken cutlet hero ever !!
they have a quality selection of deli meats and cheeses.

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Some reviewers find prices good, cheap or reasonable, while others call the place a little expensive or overpriced.
quotes: cheap prices and food so delicious.
They messed up our order in multiple ways and is so overpriced.

themes.label: Staff friendliness and rudeness
themes.text: Reviewers split: several describe friendly, kind staff, while others report rude employees, poor service, and disrespect toward customers.
quotes: Friendly staff, food always fresh.
Employees were rude and tried to charge me for a cup of tap water.

themes.label: Skimpy meat portions
themes.text: Many reviewers say staff put too little meat or toppings on sandwiches and have to be asked for more.
quotes: I always have to ask for more meat, cheese and toppings.
They literally shake crumbs of meat out of the spoon right in front of you like every crumb matters.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Reviewers find prices high for what they get, with sandwiches costing around $11 and prices rising, though one found good quality for the price.
quotes: I got charged 11 dollars for a chicken sandwich and they only put 1 and half scoops of chicken
Very good quality for price paid.

themes.label: Food freshness and quality
themes.text: Several reviewers describe the sandwiches, toppings and bread as fresh and good, though one found the bread stale.
quotes: It was clean and the sandwich was fresh.
the bread and quality is awful the bread was falling apart and stale

themes.label: Atmosphere and speakeasy basement
themes.text: Reviewers love the lively, cool vibe and the secret downstairs room reached through the kitchen, though many warn it is hard to book.
quotes: It's like a taco speakeasy. The best spot in NY. Atmosphere and decor are so cool.
Secret downstairs restaurant through the kitchen. Great food and atmosphere.

themes.label: Tacos and Mexican dishes
themes.text: Many praise the tacos, corn on the cob, ceviche and guacamole, while a few find the food inauthentic, small or underwhelming.
quotes: Service is slow, but tacos are great. Bisteca taco is awesome.
Amazing fresh and fruity ceviche. Creamy guac to die for.

themes.label: Loud music
themes.text: Reviewers note the music and noise are very loud, making conversation hard; some accept it as part of the fun.
quotes: Only problem is the music. It's just so loud it's impossible to stay more than an hour.
Loud music - don't expect to be able to talk. But it's worth.

themes.label: Service quality and speed
themes.text: Some find staff friendly and attentive, while others report slow service, mistakes, or rude treatment.
quotes: the staff is very attentive and friendly.
the staff is rude, and the service is absurdly slow.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some call it pricey for small portions, while others say it is fair or worth the cost.
quotes: It is pricey, but good value for money if you can afford it.
Pricy for no reason honestly

themes.label: Authenticity of Malaysian food
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food authentic and reminiscent of home, but some Malaysian-experienced diners find flavours not quite right or underwhelming.
quotes: the most authentic Nasi Lemak you can find in NYC
The dishes honestly lacked in soul, it didn't have the flavours and spices of Malaysia.

themes.label: Nasi lemak quality
themes.text: Nasi lemak is often praised as a signature dish, but some found it ordinary, with too little or poor sambal.
quotes: Nasi lemak is A+, ondeh2 is a tad too mushy but still darn good
Ordered their Nasi Lemak only to be disappointed by both the taste and portion of their sambal.

themes.label: Coffee, teh tarik and drinks
themes.text: Coffee and teh tarik are often praised as excellent, though some found the tea weak and drinks watered down.
quotes: The food was good, but their coffee.. Their coffee was EXCELLENT!
The tea was weak and not sweet enough compared to the tea I am used to in Malaysia and Singapore.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, helpful, quick service, but others report silent or inattentive staff and a long wait to be served.
quotes: The staff is so friendly and helpful if you are not sure what to order.
I was seated but ignored for service for 30 minutes.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Reviewers often call prices reasonable and affordable, while others find the portions small or the cost high for what you get.
quotes: The portions are good for the price and the desserts are excellent.
Flavours were not balanced and portions very small.

themes.label: Better than Chipotle
themes.text: Many reviewers compare it favourably with Chipotle and Dos Toros, calling it tastier, fresher, more authentic and cheaper, though one prefers Chipotle.
quotes: A much, much, much better version of Chipotle.
One step better than Chipotle and definitely one giant leap better than Dos Toros.

themes.label: Friendly staff and service
themes.text: Reviewers frequently praise friendly, quick service, though one found staff unfriendly and another said their order was handled poorly.
quotes: Friendly, quick, clean service.
The service however is not the best.

themes.label: Value and prices
themes.text: Most reviewers find prices fair and cheap for the portions, though a few call it expensive or note extra charges for guacamole and cheese.
quotes: Hands down best bang for your buck, chipotle is nothing compared to this
Good but slightly overpriced. An extra $2.50 for guac and $1 for cotija cheese.

themes.label: Generous portions
themes.text: Reviewers say servings are large and filling, especially the naked burritos and meat.
quotes: they give a very generous and hefty portion of meat surprisingly
you can share your dishes and reduce calories because of the large servings.

themes.label: Fresh authentic flavour
themes.text: Reviewers describe the food as fresh, tasty and authentically Mexican, with praise for burritos, tacos and sauces.
quotes: Really good, authentic Mexican food, I will definitely be going there again next time I'm in New York
You can taste the quality of the foods, fresh and hand made.

themes.label: Large banh mi sandwiches

themes.text: Many warn that the red hot sauce is extremely hot, even for people used to spice, while white sauce is praised.
quotes: The spicy sauce is really spicy.
White sauce was 10/10 delicious. The red sauce was liquid fire.

themes.label: Food taste and hype
themes.text: Many call the food delicious and the best in the city, but others find it bland, overhyped or worse than before.
quotes: Their food is extremely tasteless which I can rate as bland
The best halal in New York City

themes.label: Cleanliness concerns
themes.text: Some reviewers complain about dirt, litter, smell and food handling, while one notes staff wearing masks and gloves.
quotes: the food is good, the convenience is bad, and the cleanliness is awful.
the area is dirtier than it used to be.

themes.label: Birria tacos quality
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly call the birria tacos among the best they have had, praising flavor, tender meat and texture.
quotes: Tacos have an outer crispy layer and a soft layer. Meat is well seasoned and tender.
the meat is really tender and the consome really brings the dish together.

themes.label: Consomé broth
themes.text: The consomé is praised as flavorful and a must-get for dipping tacos, with some saying it rivals the tacos.
quotes: You gotta get the consume and dip the tacos in that lovely broth. Magic right there.
Consome arguably better than taco, but that's splitting hairs.

themes.label: Long lines, worth waiting
themes.text: Many describe long lines and waits of 40 minutes or an hour, but nearly all say the food justified it.
quotes: I literally waited for 40 mins for this, it was totally worth the wait.
The only bad thing about this taco spot is that there's always a wait

themes.label: Low prices, good value
themes.text: Reviewers find the food cheap or fairly priced for the quality and portions.
quotes: Between my husband , child & I we spend 35$ for 9 tacos 1 soup & 2 sodas .
It's also insanely cheap. Staff is also very kind.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Most describe friendly, fast staff and a clean truck, though one reviewer found a worker curt about splitting the consomé.
quotes: Place is clean. And the owner and workers are friendly.
The guy aggressively said "no, and to move on with the order".

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Early reviewers praised delicious food, but most later reviewers found it bland, burnt, spoiled, cold or otherwise bad, and some reported hair or bugs.
quotes: Delicious food. Excellent friendly service. Greatest value.
The food is bland and no seasonings at all! Please learn to season your food before opening a restaurant!

themes.label: Rude owner and staff
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the owner and staff as rude or dismissive, though early reviews called the service friendly and courteous.
quotes: Simply terrible service, owner, Svitlana Flom, take some classes and educate themselves on the proper way to treat people.
the owner/manger whoever she was is extremely rude. With a take it or leave it attitude.

themes.label: Discrimination claims
themes.text: Several reviewers say they were turned away, ignored or threatened with police because of their skin color or ethnicity.
quotes: The owner of the restaurant threatening to call the cop on me because I was non-white
I was told I couldn't eat here because of my skin color.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Later reviewers call the food overpriced for its portion size and quality, while one early reviewer found it good value.
quotes: food was below average and too expensive for the portion size and taste
Overpriced terribly burnt food and rude staff backed up by the owner who is even worse.

themes.label: Cleanliness and atmosphere
themes.text: Early reviewers liked the cosy, pleasant room, but later ones described a dirty restaurant, filthy bathroom or drab atmosphere.
quotes: Pleasant atmosphere. Fast and courteous cervice.
The restaurant was very dirty with food and grime on the floor and tables.

themes.label: Fresh, tasty food
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the food as fresh, delicious and high quality, though one reviewer said quality dropped and another found the fried fish mostly breading.
quotes: the food they serve is so fresh and tasty
The food is always fresh and delicious and will recommend it to others

themes.label: Reasonable prices
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly call the prices reasonable, affordable or a good deal.
quotes: Very good, clean and reasonable prices! Highly recommend!
The food is fresh and fast. The price is very reasonable. We will come again!

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many praise friendly, attentive service, but a few describe a rude phone worker, a cashier refusing pennies, and an order dispute with no credit.
quotes: Service is very good and attentive.
She hung up on me, I ordered 2 simple things.

themes.label: Delivery and speed
themes.text: Most say delivery and food arrive fast and on time, but one reviewer reported a very slow delivery and another had trouble with delivery change.
quotes: The food was delivered within the prescribed time, it was fresh and great.

themes.label: Cleanliness
themes.text: Several reviewers call the food and place clean, but one saw a dropped eggroll put back with the cooked ones.
quotes: The food is very tasty. Very clean!
a cooked eggroll was dropped on the floor

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise attentive, friendly, quick waiters and hosts, though a few report rude staff, slow food, or a very slow check.
quotes: Rude waiters, overpriced and mediocre seafood.not worth the trip

themes.label: Food quality and freshness
themes.text: Reviewers frequently call the seafood fresh and delicious, praising lobster rolls, crab legs, shrimp and fish, though a few found it ordinary.
quotes: People say fish is fish, not at Lobster House. The fish is cooked to perfection
We travel from Long Island for the BEST seafood...delicious & FRESH!

themes.label: Large portions and freebies
themes.text: Diners describe huge portions plus complimentary starters, desserts and amaretto, though one reviewer found a broiled platter skimpy for its price.
quotes: Stuffed our faces food was amazing they really feed you here
We also got a complimentary salad, dessert, and after dinner aperitif. It was definitely amaretto.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some find prices fair for the portions, while others call the restaurant pricey or overpriced, citing a lobster surcharge and holiday increases.
quotes: It's a bit pricey but the portions and taste match that price.
Lobster was good but the restaurant added a $5lb surcharge.

themes.label: Atmosphere and outdoor view
themes.text: Many enjoy the waterside deck, sunset view and boat-themed decor, but one found it too loud and another thought it looked worn.
quotes: sit out back on a warm day for the westward facing sunset view!
It was very loud couldn't talk comfortably gave me a headache, we had to leave

themes.label: Meal taste and recipes
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the meals as delicious, creative and easy to follow, and some say the kits taught them new dishes.
quotes: The food is top quality, flavorful, healthy & inventive. The recipes are easy to make.

themes.label: Spoiled or poor ingredients
themes.text: Many reviewers received moldy, rotten, wilted or buggy produce and spoiled meat, which cost them trust and meals.
quotes: the last 2 orders came with moldy green beans and chicken that felt like rubber
Another recipe had sun dried tomatoes that were rotten, and a third recipe had a peach that was rotten.

themes.label: Missing or wrong ingredients
themes.text: Reviewers report boxes lacking main ingredients such as meat or garlic, or containing the wrong item, though some received prompt credits.
quotes: One meal was made with salmon and the salmon was missing, the chicken receipe was missing the chicken
I got sent the wrong ingredient for a cabbage slaw (bag of iceberg lettuce instead).

themes.label: Late or poor delivery
themes.text: Reviewers complain of boxes arriving a day late or very late at night, plus courier problems, though one says orders came on time.
quotes: I ended up canceling my subscription after 2 weeks because both weeks the box arrived a day late.
I am deactivating my account due to poor delivery service through Fed Ex.

themes.label: Customer service
themes.text: Some found support kind and quick to credit or refund, while others could not reach anyone or were refused refunds.
quotes: I tried numerous times to call customer service each time I never reached a rep and was disconnected.
Customer service has been great for this company thus far!

themes.label: Slow service and waits
themes.text: Many reviewers describe long waits, especially at the drive-through, with some reporting 20 to 45 minutes, though a few say service was fast.
quotes: Long wait at drive through took over 20 minutes. Tightest driveway ever!! Trucks will curb your rims for sure.
They take forever at this place. The employees work at their own pace.

themes.label: Staff friendliness
themes.text: Many reviewers found staff friendly and pleasant, while others reported rude, unhappy or unprofessional employees.
quotes: I'm always happy to come here. Everyone is friendly and the food is good.
the gentleman that was taking my order was very rude and unprofessional.

themes.label: Cleanliness of dining area
themes.text: Some reviewers praise a clean dining area and bathrooms, while others found dirty tables, carpet and no clean trays.
quotes: The tables and carpet were dirty. Food cold
Clean eating area. If someone spilled it someone is there to clean it.

themes.label: Order accuracy and training
themes.text: Several reviewers say orders are often wrong and staff need better training, though one says their order is always right.
quotes: These people never gets your order right. They need to tran they employees better.
No reason to mess up orders especially when it isn't a rush hour.

themes.label: Food quality and value
themes.text: Reviewers often call the food fresh, hot and good, and like the 4 for 4 deal and affordable prices, though some mention cold food or salty fries.
quotes: the food there it's hot and fresh all the time
Great food at affordable prices

themes.label: Long waits
themes.text: Many reviewers say food takes a long time, sometimes over an hour, though some feel the food is worth waiting for.
quotes: Food at this place is absolutely delicious but the wait time is too long.
The only thing is the wait, but the food is fresh and good so u have to expect a wait.

themes.label: Food quality and flavor
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the fish, shrimp, salmon, mac and cheese and soul food, though a few found dishes bland, salty or undercooked.
quotes: If you are a seafood lover you're in heaven.
Shrimp and salmon alfredo is amazing!! They have great portions.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Reviewers disagree: some find staff friendly and quick, while many describe rude attitudes, disorganization and mishandled orders.
quotes: The staff is rude..but the food makes up for their ways.
Service was quick, cashier was friendly, order was correct, food tasted good.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some see low prices and good lunch portions, while others report price increases and extra charges that feel expensive.
quotes: A little expensive for simple fish. Other fish stores or restaurants have similar taste for a lot less
Definitely wonderful place and authentic food, and low prices.

themes.label: Roast beef sandwiches
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly call the roast beef sandwich, often with cheese, the best around and the main reason to visit.
quotes: Best Roast Beef with cheese hands down, plus amazing lemonade and corn fritters
The most incredible roast beef sandwich. Razor thin sliced roast beef give it a cotton candy like texture that just bites through with ease

themes.label: Cheese fries and sides
themes.text: Cheese fries are praised as among the best, along with lemonade and milkshakes, though one reviewer found the house fries awful and another found fries tasteless.
quotes: Great Roast Beef Sandwiches. But best of all, the CHEESE FRIES. THE BEST.
The house fries are really chips they were horrible. Never getting that again.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some call prices reasonable or good for a budget, while others find it expensive or overpriced, and one says prices became inflated.
quotes: Decent food, not expensive, good place for a bite on a budget
Great food but the prices became waaaay too inflated

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Reviewers split on staff, with some finding them friendly and fast and others describing discourteous or nasty service.
quotes: The service is fast and the staff is very friendly.
The most discourteous staff in all of Brooklyn - no business or customer service sense

themes.label: Crowds and waiting
themes.text: The place gets crowded, noisy and slow at times, though one reviewer says the long wait is worth it.
quotes: The wait can be long but perfection takes time. The wait is totally worth it!
it gets very crowded and at times a little insane and wait times tend to be long

themes.label: Retro 60s design
themes.text: Reviewers love the preserved mid-century terminal, the retro decor and the nostalgic feel of stepping back in time.
quotes: OMG, a perfect restoration to teleport you back to the 60's
Spectacular design, mind-blowing attention to detail, a master-class in branding.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Some guests praise friendly, helpful staff, while others report rude or untrained front desk staff and impersonal kiosk check-in.
quotes: Extremely rude front staff.....need to step up your game!! What about some customer service!
First class customer service!

themes.label: Rooms and beds
themes.text: Rooms are often called quiet and comfortable with good beds, but some find them small, dirty or lacking amenities.
quotes: The room had a very comfortable bed and it was quite.
got to our room to discover an unflushed toilet and a dirty washcloth in the shower.

themes.label: Food and drink prices
themes.text: Several reviewers find food and drinks pricey, though some praise the food quality and cocktails.
quotes: Cool trip back in time except for the 5 dollar cup of coffee
Food is a little pricey, but that's to be expected.

themes.label: Rooftop pool and bars
themes.text: Guests enjoy the rooftop pool and bar views and the cocktails in the Constellation plane lounge.
quotes: Great, unique view; and much less expensive than other rooftops around the city
heated rooftop pool was still open and worthy of a dip even when it's 35f outside
